name: Inami Maho
source: She's about the same height as her mother, however she has mismatching large breasts. She's cheerful and peppy , sociable and cute-lookng. When they were kids, she always clinged to her older brother…… So, she's an extreme brocon: Her first kiss, her first time, her first pregnancy, all of this she has settled on having with her dear Onii-chan.
